resolution: Compile button had zero feedback ('0 ux on the button'), and glass renders in standalone rjit game play but not the editor /compiled route. Two parts: (1) UX — the pill now shows compiling/done/error + a readable one-liner carrying the bake's new [materials] breadcrumb (encodeMaterials logs 'N material(s): X shader, Y translucent', captured via 2>&1), so the user can confirm glass IS in the gamefile, with a note that Compile re-bakes DATA only. (2) Root cause of glass not in /compiled: the /compiled route renders world_loader EMBEDDED in the dev host (v8_app), a different binary than the freshly-built standalone; rjit dev fingerprints native inputs and the running host is STALE after the world_loader.zig glass change — its detector even says 'STALE DEV HOST … kill the running dev host (ctrl-c its terminal) and rerun this command'. Clicking Compile cannot fix that (data only). Fix for the user: Ctrl-C the rjit dev terminal and re-run rjit dev hmsc-int to rebuild the host with the glass loader. All changes hot-reloadable TSX + re-bundled bake.
